tagline: Every requirement. Its source. Your documents.
description: Upload a hiring requirements PDF and the related HR documents. For every finding you get the source page and a verified exact quote, possible document matches, and gaps for human review.
boundaryBody: Results are suggestions and need human review. The tool gives no verdict on who to hire, legal compliance, or whether a contract is valid. The final call is yours.
notOfficial: Not an HR system of record. It does not hire, write contracts, or contact candidates.
sampleTitle: This card does not come from an analysis
sampleBody: The lines below show what a result looks like. No file was read and no model was called.
sampleRequirement: The candidate must provide a signed employment contract.
sampleQuote: The candidate must provide a copy of the signed employment contract.
waitingWorker: The job is queued. If this does not change, check that the worker process is running.
stale: This is taking longer than expected. Refresh the page. Your files are not deleted.
unreadable: Some pages could not be read. OCR is off in this demo, so those pages are not part of the analysis.
duplicate: A copy of the same file was kept and not merged.
noRequirements: No findings were extracted from the readable pages. An empty result is not counted as success.
notFoundDetail: This does not mean the person has no such document. It was only not found in the uploaded files.
quoteVerified: Page and exact quote checked against the extracted text
quoteUnverified: The page or exact quote could not be matched to the extracted text, so no source is shown.

applicant.title: Applicant
applicant.hint: Each CV is one person. Choose a name to see which requirements that applicant meets.
applicant.name: Applicant name
applicant.notInCv: Not found in {name}'s CV. This does not mean the person has no such document.

evidenceHint: Add CVs, contracts, and certificates to this analysis. Matches are shown only as possible supporting documents.
confirmDelete: Delete this analysis and its uploaded files?
noteRequired: Write a short note for this decision.
commentRequired: Write the comment text before saving.
statementRequired: Write the corrected text before saving the edit.

header.quotaTitle: Free analysis allowance and demo plan

footer.boundary: The tool organizes hiring documents. It does not decide who to hire, legal compliance, or whether a contract is valid, and it does not write contracts.
footer.official: Not an HR system of record. It does not hire candidates, write contracts, or contact people.
footer.demo: The demo subscription does not process real payments. Sample documents are fictional.

hero.title: Match hiring requirements to the uploaded documents
hero.chipSource: Page and exact quote for every finding

upload.title: Upload the requirements PDF
upload.body: The document is read page by page. Page numbers match the original PDF.

company.title: Add HR documents
company.body: Upload CVs, contracts, and certificates. You can keep them in My documents.

review.title: Review with sources
review.body: Every finding shows its source file, page, and verified quote. Confirm, edit, reject, or comment.

export.title: Export the checklist
export.body: Download a CSV checklist together with your human decisions.

finds.title: What the tool looks at
finds.subtitle: Findings are suggestions. Each one comes with its source and is marked for human review.
finds.required_document: Documents the requirements file asks for, and possible supporting documents in your uploaded files.
finds.missing: Requirements not found in the uploaded files. This does not mean the document does not exist.
finds.deadline: Dates, notice periods, and other timelines.
finds.technical_mismatch: Possible mismatches between a stated requirement and an uploaded document.
finds.contract_terms: Contract terms that may need attention, including pay, notice, and duties.

boundary.l1: It does not decide who to hire or whether someone is eligible.
boundary.l2: It does not write contracts or submit hiring documents.
boundary.l3: It does not promise a hiring outcome and shows no score or probability.
boundary.l4: “Not found in uploaded files” never means the document does not exist.

new.title: New analysis
new.subtitle: Choose the requirements PDF, optionally add HR documents, and pick the language of the findings.
new.errName: Give the analysis a name of at least 2 characters.
new.tenderHint: PDF only. Up to {mb} MB and {pages} pages.
new.companyHint: Optional. You can also add them later. Documents are read only to support this analysis.
new.libraryEmpty: My documents is empty. Upload documents once and reuse them in every analysis:
new.findingLanguageHint: Explanations are written in the chosen language. Source quotes stay in the original language of the document.
new.sendNotice: Files are sent by the server to the configured AI service. Use only an approved environment for real confidential documents.
new.setupHint: Local Qwen stays on this machine. A Gemini key, if you use one, stays on the server only.
new.privacyBody: Uploaded files are stored outside the public web folder. You can delete them at any time in My documents and Analysis history.

sample.title: Fictional sample pack
sample.body: The requirements file and HR documents are fictional. The result is labeled apart from live results and does not use the free allowance.
sample.banner: Sample mode: the documents are fictional. This result is not about a real candidate or a real company.

history.title: Analysis history
history.subtitle: Reopen earlier analyses, continue your review decisions, or delete them.
history.emptyBody: Start your first analysis. Results will be kept here.
history.deleted: The analysis and its files were deleted.
history.quotaNote: Deleting an analysis does not restore the free allowance.

documents.title: My documents
documents.subtitle: Upload HR documents once, then pick them in analyses.
documents.privacy: Upload only test and fictional documents. Real confidential documents should not be sent to a model service in the demo environment.
documents.hint: Each file up to {mb} MB. Up to {max} documents are kept.
documents.emptyBody: Upload CV, contract, and certificate PDFs.
documents.deleted: Document deleted. Copies inside existing analyses remain.

plan.title: Plan
plan.subtitle: The first analyses are free. After that a demo monthly plan is needed.
plan.freeRule: Only successfully completed analyses count. Failed, incomplete, and API-error attempts do not count. Opening the same analysis again does not count twice.
plan.freeUsedUp: The free analyses are used. Activate the demo plan to start a new analysis.
plan.demoOnly: Demo price only — not a real price.
plan.noCard: No card details are asked for.
plan.noCharge: No real payment or charge happens.
plan.activeUntil: The demo plan is active until {date}.
plan.expiredOn: The demo plan expired on {date}. Confirm again to start a new analysis.
plan.honest: This is a demo simulation. It connects to no payment provider and processes no real payment.
plan.accessBody: This MVP has one local workspace and no login. The allowance and subscription state are stored on the server. Real customer access needs authentication and authorization.

results.aiBanner: All findings are AI suggestions and need human review. The tool gives no verdict on who to hire.
results.working: The analysis is running. This page updates when results are ready.
results.matchHint: Matching needs findings and at least one HR PDF.
results.matchWording: Results are shown as “possible supporting document” and need human review.

summary.title: Counts
summary.note: These counters only count findings. There is no overall score, hire decision, or probability.

exportPage.title: Export
exportPage.c1: Finding, category, severity, explanation, and next step.
exportPage.c2: Source file, page, and verified quote. Unverified ones are marked “source not verified”.
exportPage.c3: Possible document matches, human decisions, and notes.
exportPage.c4: Cells that could be read as formulas are written safely.
exportPage.empty: There are no findings to export.
exportPage.openItems: {n} of {total} findings have no human decision. They export as not reviewed.
exportPage.unverified: {n} findings have no verified source. The file marks them as “source not verified”.
exportPage.limits: The export is an organizing aid. It is not a decision on who to hire, legal compliance, or whether a contract is valid.

errors.unsupported_file_type: Only PDF is accepted. The file extension and content must match. Check the file and upload it again.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than the demo limit.
errors.page_limit_exceeded: The page count is over the demo limit.
errors.pdf_encrypted: The PDF is password protected. Remove the password and upload it again.
errors.pdf_unreadable: The PDF could not be read or has no usable text.
errors.ocr_unavailable: Scanned pages are not read in this demo. OCR is off.
errors.model_not_configured: No AI model is configured. For local Qwen, set MODEL_PROVIDER=ollama and run Ollama with qwen2.5:7b-instruct. Or set GEMINI_API_KEY. Then restart the API and the worker.
errors.model_auth_failed: The model service rejected the server key. Check the value and permissions of GEMINI_API_KEY.
errors.model_rejected: The model service rejected the request or the model name. For Qwen, run ollama pull qwen2.5:7b-instruct. For Gemini, check GEMINI_MODEL_ID.
errors.model_rate_limited: The model service limit was reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.model_timeout: The model did not answer in time. No partial list was saved, and you can try again.
errors.model_output_invalid: The model answer could not be used. No partial list was saved.
errors.request_too_large: The documents are too large to send to the model. Choose fewer or shorter PDFs.
errors.plan_required: The free analyses are used. Activate the demo monthly plan to start another analysis.
errors.payments_disabled: Demo payment is turned off in this environment.
errors.analysis_not_found: This analysis was not found or was deleted.
errors.document_not_found: The document was not found or was deleted.
errors.duplicate_file: This file is already in My documents.
errors.too_many_files: The file limit was exceeded. Remove or delete some files.
errors.note_required: Write a short note for this decision.
errors.statement_required: Write the corrected text before saving the edit.
errors.review_invalid: The decision could not be saved. Check the decision and the text length.
errors.export_failed: This action is not available right now. Wait for processing to finish, check the state, and try again.
errors.api_unreachable: The API does not respond. If the backend is running, try again in a moment.
errors.api_down: The API does not respond. If the backend is running, try again in a moment.
errors.generic: The action did not complete. Nothing was replaced with an empty result.
